title: EmojieTab
description: Emoji near your name that changes color by dimension.
body:
_This plugin was developed for my Minecraft server running Paper 1.21.1. I believe it might support higher versions too, but I **can't guarantee** it will work correctly on those._

This plugin adds fun emoji next to player names in the tab list — and as a bonus, the emoji also reflects the dimension the player is currently in! :)

_The plugin was inspired by the Makoto server._

## THIS PLUGIN INCLUDES SOME COMMANDS

- `/status <Player> <1 emoji character>`  
  **Example:** `/status Alexsam1075 🌷`  
  _(By the way, the tulip looks really cute in the tab list!)_

- `/editstatus <1 emoji character>` — changes the emoji in the tab list for the player who runs the command

- `/emojiinv` — shows your collected emojis

- `/emojie trade <player>` — start a trade with another player
- `/emojie trade accept` — accept an incoming trade
- `/emojie trade decline` — decline an incoming trade
- `/emojie trade cancel` — cancel your outgoing trade

- `/emojie gift <player>` — gift an emoji to someone (works even if offline!)

The plugin also includes a config file!  
There, you can:
- Set the default emoji
- Change the tab list color for each dimension
- And tweak a few other things... I honestly don't remember all of them XD

## ADDITIONAL FEATURES

- **Emoji Inventory** — each player has a personal collection of emojis
- **Trade System** — exchange emojis with other players (with timer)
- **Gift System** — give emojis to offline and online players
- **PlaceholderAPI support** — `%emojistatus_emoji%` for use in other plugins

If you encounter any problems, message me on Telegram! @AlexsandrDeveloper  
_(Also message me if you're interested in buying the plugin's source code)_

If you liked the plugin, I would **REALLY** appreciate a donation ❤️
